opening.argument: The video presents a walkthrough for checking eligibility and claiming a described SOL airdrop through a wallet, with no staking or deposit required. It instructs viewers to enter a Solana wallet address and check whether it has been validated, while the description warns them never to share a seed phrase and states that legitimate airdrops require only wallet connection. The eligibility result displays a 10.0 SOL reward and a claim control. A separate wallet panel shows a password prompt beside the address form, but those visible cues do not, on their own, establish deceptive conduct or a completed transfer.

citations.quote: show exactly how to claim free $SOL using your Phantom wallet — no staking or deposits required.
First, click the check Eligibility button, then enter your Solana wallet address, and click it and check whether it has been validated.
Never share your seed phrase. Legitimate airdrops only require wallet connection — nothing else.
